diagnostics.title: Unsupported coverage attribute placement
diagnostics.when: the attribute is not followed by an item or statement (an expression, a match arm, a field, a variant, a parameter, `else`, a lone `;`, a closing `}`, a `use` or `module` declaration, the end of the file), or its mode cannot apply to the construct it attaches to; an `ignore-next` directive with no code after it in its file, or whose next code is not an item, a statement, or an `if` or `match` expression; an `ignore-start` region with no code; in a coverage build, an exclusion that takes nothing the coverage planner planned, and `contract_off` until contract coverage exists (sv0cov CV-306)

diagnostics.title: Invalid coverage exclusion
diagnostics.when: the content is not exactly `coverage(<mode>, reason = "<text>")`: no argument list, an `= literal` form, an unknown or differently cased mode, the mode not first, a missing mode, a duplicate or extra argument, a nested argument list, a reason that is not a string literal, is longer than 1,024 bytes, or holds a NUL, CR or LF (or an escape above `0x7e`); or a rejected namespace spelling; a comment directive that is not spelled exactly as section 6 says (not alone on its line, a block or doc comment, another spacing or case, an unknown action, a reason not written `reason="..."`, unclosed or longer than 1,024 bytes, text after it); an `ignore-end` without a start, or an `ignore-start` never closed in its file; an `ignore-start` region that does not begin and end between the items or statements of one block

diagnostics.title: Conflicting coverage exclusions
diagnostics.when: a comment directive and an `off` or `branch_off` attribute name the same construct

diagnostics.title: Redundant coverage exclusion
diagnostics.when: one construct has the same mode twice, or `off` together with `branch_off`; or an exclusion lies inside the subtree of an enclosing `off` (or comment directive) whose effect already includes it; a directive inside an open `ignore-start` region, or between an `ignore-next` and its construct

diagnostics.title: Coverage exclusion has no reason
diagnostics.when: the `reason` argument (or a directive's `reason=`) is missing, or its string is empty

directives.attempt: a line or block comment whose text, after the comment opener and spaces or tabs, starts with `sv0cov:` compared without regard to ASCII case
directives.nesting: none: a directive inside an open region, or between an ignore-next and its construct, is redundant

resolution.ignore-next: the next item, statement, or if/match expression after attributes, use/module declarations and items with no code
resolution.region: between the items or statements of one block

directives.separator: one or more spaces or tabs; only spaces or tabs after the last part

modes.attaches_to: a `fn`, or an `impl` or `trait` with at least one function body, or any statement
modes.effect: excludes the ordinary coverage (function, region, derived line, branch) of the construct and its whole ordinary subtree; contract clauses stay measured
modes.name: off

modes.effect: excludes only the outcomes the decision owns directly; its region, line, body and nested decisions stay ordinary
modes.name: branch_off

modes.attaches_to: a `fn` that owns at least one contract clause
modes.effect: removes the clauses the function owns directly from contract-coverage denominators; enforcement, proof disposition and ordinary coverage are unchanged
modes.name: contract_off

rejected_namespaces.rule: any attribute path other than exactly `coverage` whose single segment, or last segment, equals `coverage` or `sv0cov` when compared without regard to ASCII case
